title: Give a thing and take it back

anchor.text: Give a thing and take it back
anchor.prefix:
back that potato, will you? 

 ZOE 

 Forfeits, a fine thing and a superfine thing. 

 BLOOM 

(With feeling.) It is nothing, but still, a relic of poor mamma. 

1939#391
